sql.content: INSERT INTO :tableName ( assetID ,assetState ,isDel ,createUserID ,updateUserID ,createTime ,updateTime :1DataName ) VALUES ( ':assetID' ,':assetState' ,':isDel' ,':createUserID' ,':updateUserID' ,':createTime' ,':updateTime' :1DataValue )
UPDATE :tableName SET updateTime = ':updateTime' ,updateUserID = ':updateUserID' ,isDel = ':isDel' ,assetState = ':assetState' :1SetS WHERE assetID = ':assetID'
UPDATE :tableName SET updateTime = SYSDATE ,updateUserID = ':updateUserID' ,assetState = :assetState WHERE assetID IN ( :assetIDs )
UPDATE :tableName SET updateTime = SYSDATE ,updateUserID = ':updateUserID' ,assetState = :assetState WHERE assetID IN ( :assetIDs )
UPDATE :tableName SET updateTime = LOCALTIMESTAMP ,updateUserID = ':updateUserID' ,assetState = :assetState WHERE assetID IN ( :assetIDs )
UPDATE :tableName SET updateTime = NOW() ,updateUserID = ':updateUserID' ,assetState = :assetState WHERE assetID IN ( :assetIDs )
UPDATE :tableName SET updateTime = DATETIME('now') ,updateUserID = ':updateUserID' ,assetState = :assetState WHERE assetID IN ( :assetIDs )
UPDATE :tableName SET updateTime = now() ,updateUserID = ':updateUserID' ,assetState = :assetState WHERE assetID IN ( :assetIDs )
SELECT COUNT(1) AS ProbeData_IsExists FROM :tableName WHERE assetID = ':assetID' FOR UPDATE
SELECT assetID FROM :tableName WHERE isDel = 0 :1WhereNV
SELECT LEFT(MAX(assetID) ,17) AS AssetID FROM :tableName WHERE assetID LIKE '%:Source' AND createTime >= SYSDATE - 3
SELECT SUBSTR(MAX(assetID) ,1 ,17) AS AssetID FROM :tableName WHERE assetID LIKE '%:Source' AND createTime >= SYSDATE - 3
SELECT LEFT(MAX(assetID) ,17) AS AssetID FROM :tableName WHERE assetID LIKE '%:Source' AND createTime >= LOCALTIMESTAMP - make_interval(days => 3)
SELECT LEFT(MAX(assetID) ,17) AS AssetID FROM :tableName WHERE assetID LIKE '%:Source' AND createTime >= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -3 DAY)
SELECT SUBSTR(MAX(assetID) ,1 ,17) AS AssetID FROM :tableName WHERE assetID LIKE '%:Source' AND createTime >= DATETIME('now' ,'-3 day')
SELECT SUBSTRING(MAX(assetID) ,FROM 1 FOR 17) AS AssetID FROM :tableName WHERE assetID LIKE '%:Source' AND createTime >= now() - (3.0 * 24.0 * 60.0 * 60.0 * 1000.0)

SELECT WA.* ( SELECT LEFT(assetID ,17) AS assetID ,isDel ,updateUserID :1DataName FROM :tableName WHERE assetState = 0 AND updateTime >= SYSDATE - 10 AND assetID LIKE '%:Source' ORDER BY updateTime ) WA WHERE ROWNUM <= :MaxCount

SELECT LEFT(assetID ,17) AS assetID ,isDel ,updateUserID :1DataName FROM :tableName WHERE assetState = 0 AND updateTime >= LOCALTIMESTAMP - make_interval(days => 10) AND assetID LIKE '%:Source' ORDER BY updateTime LIMIT :MaxCount

SELECT LEFT(assetID ,17) AS assetID ,isDel ,updateUserID :1DataName FROM :tableName WHERE assetState = 0 AND updateTime >= DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -10 DAY) AND assetID LIKE '%:Source' ORDER BY updateTime LIMIT 0 ,:MaxCount

SELECT SUBSTR(assetID ,1 ,17) AS assetID ,isDel ,updateUserID :1DataName FROM :tableName WHERE assetState = 0 AND updateTime >= DATETIME('now' ,'-10 day') AND assetID LIKE '%:Source' ORDER BY updateTime LIMIT :MaxCount

SELECT SUBSTRING(assetID ,FROM 1 FOR 17) AS assetID ,isDel ,updateUserID :1DataName FROM :tableName WHERE assetState = 0 AND updateTime >= now() - (10.0 * 24.0 * 60.0 * 60.0 * 1000.0) AND assetID LIKE '%:Source' ORDER BY updateTime LIMIT :MaxCount

SELECT assetID AS "assetID" ,assetState AS "assetState" ,isDel AS "isDel" ,createUserID AS "createUserID" ,updateUserID AS "updateUserID" ,TO_CHAR(createTime ,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "createTime" ,TO_CHAR(updateTime ,'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS "updateTime" :1DataName FROM :tableName WHERE <[ AND assetID = ':assetID' ]> <[ AND assetState = ':assetState' ]> <[ AND isDel = :isDel ]> <[ AND createUserID = ':createUserID' ]> <[ AND updateUserID = ':updateUserID' ]> <[ AND createTime = ':createTime' ]> <[ AND updateTime = ':updateTime' ]> <[ AND updateTime >= ':startTime' ]> <[ AND updateTime < ':endTime' ]> :1WhereNV ORDER BY updateTime <[ WHERE LIMIT :StartIndex ,:PagePerCount ]>
